about: Verifier round 6 (full) on m11/sol-fixes-1 at c08a452f: NEW attack phrasings for THE ADDING RULE version 4 (dispatch/rule-adding-v2.md, VERSION 4 f to l; version 3 a to e still hold), labelled with what the person asked for BEFORE any run and committed before any run (29 Sep 2026). 'expect' is the set of adds the draft must keep (template ids: add-measure, relate, import, add-column, calc-group, role). For a take-away phrasing expect is empty and a KEPT add is the harm the bar counts (a dropped add is reported apart). 'letter' says what the rule's own words require: 'must' = the rule's words require no add here, so a kept add is the code's defect; 'gap' = the person asked for no add but the rule's words permit one (a sign the rule does not list, a sentence end the rule draws), so a kept add is a question for the coordinator, not charged to the code. For polite adds: 'keep' = the rule's words keep the add, 'lose' = the rule's words lose it (a sign by presence), so a loss there is friction, not a defect. 'harm': 'opposite' = the add is the opposite of what the person asked (the thing added is the thing to take away). 'root' names the seam each phrasing aims at. Flows: 'compose' = compose_task with 'words'; 'more' = compose 'first' (permission given), then Add more words with 'words'; 'consent-after' = compose 'first' with permission withdrawn, give permission, then Add more words; 'point-after' = compose 'first' with the compose.draft point switched off in What Pro decides, switch it on, then Add more words; 'restart-consent-after' = compose 'first' with permission withdrawn, restart the engine (a new engine over the same workspace, the model opened again), give permission, then Add more words. Every item runs on both doors (Studio and the agent) with Jev saying no, with Jev sure of every add, with Jev off (no permission; the point switched off) and once with real Jev. Words with a line break carry it as a JSON escape.
